title: Brickstorm
description: A neon breakout forge — Classic and Zen arcade modes plus a full level editor with save, share links, and power-ups.
concept: A brick-breaker built as three distinct modes: Classic runs 8 hand-tuned procedural levels with rising difficulty, Zen is an endless wave-survival score-attack, and the Editor lets you paint your own brick layouts, save them locally, and generate a shareable link that loads the level for anyone. Six catchable power-ups (multiball, wide paddle, laser, sticky catch, slow-mo, extra core) drop from broken bricks and change how a run plays out.
features: 3 modes: Classic (8 levels), Zen (endless waves), Level Editor (paint + save + share)
6 power-ups: multiball, wide paddle, laser fire, sticky catch, slow-mo, extra core
Level editor with 5 brick types, save to localStorage, and shareable btoa/atob URL links
Persistent top-5 high scores per mode via localStorage
Touch drag + mouse + keyboard paddle control, screen shake and particle FX

interaction.mouse: Move to steer the paddle, click to launch/catch the ball
interaction.click: Launch ball, paint bricks in Editor mode, fire UI buttons
interaction.touch: Drag anywhere on the canvas to steer the paddle, tap to launch
interaction.keyboard: Arrow keys to move the paddle, Space to launch the ball
